description: resolves a bounded RFC 6901-style JSON pointer using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json pointer get result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Pointer Get as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

document.description: Document supplied to JSON Pointer Get; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

pointer.description: Pointer supplied to JSON Pointer Get; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_json_pointer_get
